newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Eurodollar futures end mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Eurodollar futures end mostly unchanged.

text.p: Nov 11 - U.S. Eurodollar futures ended an abbreviated session mostly unchanged from Friday. March ended on the downside of its two-tick range, while other contracts were steady.

Positive technical factors should lead T-bond futures higher when they re-open on Tuesday. Night pit trade will be open for bonds. GLOBEX and Project A will also be open on Monday night. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
